title: How SKY crypto’s 12% price drop raises the risk of further losses
summary: SKY faces further downside risks as derivatives activity weakens despite healthy on-chain fundamentals.
content: The cryptocurrency SKY recently experienced a 12% price drop, raising concerns among investors about the potential for further losses. Although the network's on-chain fundamentals remain healthy, weakening derivatives activity suggests that downward pressure could persist in the near term, increasing overall risk for market participants.
content_ta: SKY என்ற cryptocurrency விலையில் 12% சரிவு ஏற்பட்டுள்ளதால், மேலும் விலை குறையக்கூடும் என்ற அச்சம் முதலீட்டாளர்கள் மத்தியில் எழுந்துள்ளது. on-chain அடிப்படையிலான அம்சங்கள் ஆரோக்கியமாக இருந்தாலும், derivatives சந்தையின் செயல்பாடு மந்தமாக இருப்பதால் சந்தையில் சரிவுக்கான வாய்ப்புகள் தொடரலாம் என்று கூறப்படுகிறது.

title: Anyflo emerges from stealth to simplify stablecoin payments for enterprises
summary: Stablecoin payments orchestration service Anyflo has emerged from stealth with news that it has acquired bitcoin lending platform Native.
content: Anyflo, a stablecoin payments orchestration service, has officially emerged from stealth. Alongside this launch, the company announced its acquisition of Native, a bitcoin lending platform. The strategic move aims to simplify and enhance stablecoin payment processes for enterprise clients navigating the digital asset landscape.
content_ta: Stablecoin payments orchestration service-аான Anyflo தனது stealth நிலையிலிருந்து அதிகாரப்பூர்வமாக வெளிவந்துள்ளது. இந்த அறிமுகத்துடன், bitcoin lending platform-ஆன Native நிறுவனத்தை வாங்கியுள்ளதாகவும் இந்நிறுவனம் அறிவித்துள்ளது. டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து சந்தையில் இயங்கும் enterprise வாடிக்கையாளர்களுக்கு stablecoin payment முறைகளை எளிமையாக்குவதை இந்த மூலோபாய நடவடிக்கை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது.

title: Cantor Fitzgerald faces Senate Democrat’s questions over Tether ties
summary: The letter follows a report by the Democratic investigators last month alleging Tether’s USDT has become a key tool for Iran’s shadow banking network.
content: Cantor Fitzgerald is facing questions from Senate Democrats regarding its ties to the stablecoin issuer Tether. This inquiry follows a recent report by Democratic investigators alleging that Tether's USDT cryptocurrency has been utilized as a significant tool for Iran's shadow banking network, prompting lawmakers to demand more transparency and information concerning financial connections.
content_ta: Tether நிறுவனத்துடனான அதன் தொடர்புகள் குறித்து Senate Democrats அமைப்பினர் Cantor Fitzgerald நிறுவனத்திடம் கேள்விகளை எழுப்பி வருகின்றனர். Tether-ன் USDT கிரிப்டோகரன்சி Iran-ன் நிழல் வங்கி வலைப்பின்னலுக்கு ஒரு முக்கிய கருவியாக மாறியுள்ளதாக Democratic புலனாய்வாளர்களின் அறிக்கை வெளியானதை அடுத்து இந்த விசாரணை வந்துள்ளது.

title: Abstract’s shutdown exposes the gap between owning assets and being able to move them
summary:
Abstract sets a Dec. 15 shutdown, but wallet access, supported routes and settlement determine whether holders can complete an exit.
The post Abstract’s shutdown exposes the gap between owning assets and being able to move them appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: Abstract has announced a shutdown scheduled for December 15. The closure highlights a critical gap between simply owning digital assets and having the necessary wallet access, routes, and settlement mechanisms required to successfully move and exit those holdings. Users are now facing challenges regarding how they can withdraw or transfer their funds before the platform officially ceases operations.
content_ta: Abstract நிறுவனம் டிசம்பர் 15 அன்று தனது சேவைகளை நிறுத்த உள்ளதாக அறிவித்துள்ளது. டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்களை வைத்திருப்பதற்கும், அவற்றை வெற்றிகரமாக வெளியேற்றுவதற்குத் தேவையான வாலட் அணுகல் மற்றும் செட்டில்மெண்ட் முறைகளைக் கொண்டிருப்பதற்கும் இடையே உள்ள பெரிய இடைவெளியை இந்த மூடல் வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டுகிறது. பயனர்கள் தங்கள் நிதியை வெளியேற்றுவதில் சிக்கல்களை எதிர்கொண்டுள்ளனர்.

title: XRPL’s $1.34 billion stablecoin base doesn’t tell us how much XRP users need
summary:
Fees and reserves require XRP, while larger demand depends on routing choices and the balances held in liquidity or credit products.
The post XRPL’s $1.34 billion stablecoin base doesn’t tell us how much XRP users need appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: The XRPL network features a substantial stablecoin base of $1.34 billion, yet this figure does not accurately indicate the total amount of XRP users actually need. While transaction fees and reserve requirements demand XRP, broader token demand largely depends on complex routing choices and individual balances held in various credit or liquidity products.
content_ta: XRPL நெட்வொர்க் $1.34 பில்லியன் மதிப்பிலான ஸ்டேபிள்காயின் ஆதாரத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது, இருப்பினும் இந்த எண்ணிக்கை பயனர்களுக்கு உண்மையில் எவ்வளவு XRP தேவை என்பதைக் காட்டவில்லை. பரிவர்த்தனை கட்டணங்கள் மற்றும் இருப்புத் தேவைகளுக்கு XRP அவசியமானது, அதே நேரத்தில் பரந்த அளவிலான டோக்கன் தேவை பெரும்பாலும் ரூட்டிங் தேர்வுகள் மற்றும் கடன் அல்லது லிக்விடிட்டி தயாரிப்புகளில் வைத்திருக்கும் நிலுவைகளைப் பொறுத்தது.

title: Post-Quantum Custody Platform Strongpoint Adds Quantus As Development Partner
summary: Project Eleven and Quantus plan to integrate the Quantus Network with Strongpoint, Project Eleven's institutional custody platform for post-quantum blockchain assets. Quantus has joined as a development partner, with support targeted for the first quarter of 2027.
content: Project Eleven has added Quantus as a development partner for Strongpoint, its institutional custody platform designed for post-quantum blockchain assets. The partnership will focus on integrating the Quantus Network with Strongpoint. Full support for this integration is targeted for launch in the first quarter of 2027.
content_ta: போஸ்ட்-குவாண்டம் பிளாக்செயின் சொத்துகளுக்கான இன்ஸ்டிடியூஷனல் கஸ்டடி பிளாட்பார்மான Strongpoint-இன் மேம்பாட்டு கூட்டாளியாக Quantus இணைந்துள்ளது. title: Sui And Alibaba Cloud Want AI Agents Paying Their Own Cloud Bills In Stablecoins
summary: Sui and Alibaba Cloud are working on an integration that would let AI agents pay for cloud services per request using stablecoins within budgets set by their owners. The collaboration was unveiled at Sui Basecamp and remains under development, with no public launch date yet.
content: Sui and Alibaba Cloud are collaborating on a new integration that will allow autonomous AI agents to pay for cloud services using stablecoins. Revealed at the Sui Basecamp event, the upcoming system aims to let AI agents handle per-request billing within predefined budgets set by their human owners. The project is currently in development with no public launch date announced yet.
content_ta: Sui மற்றும் Alibaba Cloud நிறுவனங்கள் இணைந்து, AI agents-கள் stablecoins மூலம் தங்கள் கிளவுட் சேவைகளுக்கான கட்டணங்களை தாங்களே செலுத்தும் புதிய தொழில்நுட்பத்தை உருவாக்கி வருகின்றன. Sui Basecamp மாநாட்டில் அறிவிக்கப்பட்ட இந்த திட்டம், உரிமையாளர்கள் நிர்ணயித்த வரம்பிற்குள் இருந்து கொண்டு ஒவ்வொரு கோரிக்கைக்கான கட்டணத்தையும் AI agents செலுத்த வழிவகை செய்கிறது. இது தற்போது வளர்ச்சியில் உள்ளது, மேலும் இதன் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ வெளியீட்டு தேதி இன்னும் அறிவிக்கப்படவில்லை.

content: The NEAR cryptocurrency experienced a significant 16 percent drop in value, occurring just one day after Bitwise released a bullish report. Despite the downturn, the Chief Investment Officer at Bitwise highlighted NEAR as being among the few small-cap digital assets worth watching closely.

title: OpenAI pulls three AI-generated math papers one day after release
summary:
OpenAI's retraction highlights the challenges of AI in rigorous fields, emphasizing the need for transparency and robust verification processes.
The post OpenAI pulls three AI-generated math papers one day after release appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: OpenAI has retracted three artificial intelligence-generated mathematics papers just one day after their initial release. title: Nivo Launches Lender Collect: AI Case Coordination for the UK's Intermediated Lenders
summary:
Nivo has today launched Lender Collect, an AI assistant that coordinates a lending case from the first broker email through evidence gathering, underwriting preparation and the conditions that follow the lender's decision.
Lender Collect is available now to UK intermediated lenders, including bridging, specialist property, commercial and asset finance lenders. It extends the market-proven technology behind Nivo Collect, now live with over 15 brokers, to lenders, where more than 400 UK specialist and alternative lenders compete for brokers' business.
For intermediated lenders, the speed and ease of case handling help determine how much broker business they win. Yet much of the work remains manual, from keying enquiries into pricing spreadsheets and chasing statements and signatures to assembling the facts for an underwriting decision.
Getting started takes three steps: lenders provide their product guides, lending criteria, procedures, application forms and underwriter report template; Nivo configures the service around their case-handling requirements; then a case starts with a single email.
The AI reads the broker's instructions and attachments, identifies the parties, establishes amount, purpose, term, security and exit, and checks these against the lender's product criteria. It flags what fits, what needs clarifying and, where appropriate, an alternative product in the lender's range.
It requests evidence from the right people in the lender's preferred order, checks documents for completeness and consistency, populates forms, arranges signatures and sends consolidated reminders, escalating stalled cases. Company reports, identity checks and optional PEP, sanctions and adverse media screening are built in.
Before underwriting, it checks the evidence against the lender's rules and policies, raises further requests and drafts an editable report using the lender's template. This brings together the deal, criteria, evidence, calculations and discrepancies, with commentary and decision sections marked for the underwriter to confirm, amend or replace.
It then turns the underwriter's recorded conditions into document, form and signature tasks through to a signed loan agreement. Required evidence is tracked against the lender's instructions, with missing pages, conflicting details and unanswered conditions surfaced for review to reduce omissions.
Across lender contacts, brokers, applicants, guarantors, solicitors and valuers, Lender Collect tracks who owes what, completed tasks and how each connects to the next, a capability Nivo believes no other AI solution on the market offers today.
Exceptions, waivers, credit decisions and approvals stay with the lender's authorised team. Evidence gaps remain visible in the pack, including items waived or unobtainable.
Prompt, precise requests keep viable cases moving and reduce avoidable drop-off, supporting higher completion rates. Faster responses and easier case handling help lenders earn broker advocacy, repeat business and a greater share of brokers' business.
Cases progress 24/7, allowing brokers and customers to move them forward outside office hours, with a first response before a competitor has opened the email. Underwriters receive an organised pack and drafted commentary, giving the same team more capacity to focus on relationships, exceptions and lending.
Michael Common, CEO at Nivo, said:
"Every intermediated lender runs the same process: a query comes in, evidence is gathered, an underwriter decides, and the conditions are worked through to completion. The lenders that win are the ones that are fastest and easiest for brokers to deal with. Lender Collect answers in minutes rather than days, at any hour, using the lender's own criteria and documents. That is a conversion play as much as an efficiency play.
Nivo Collect showed brokers what an AI assistant can do with the gather, check and chase. Lender Collect brings that to the other side of the deal. Underwriters open a draft report built from checked evidence, with the decision firmly theirs. Nothing is approved, waived or decided by the AI."
Nivo's published security and compliance credentials include ISO 27001, ISO 9001 and ISO/IEC 42001 certification, Cyber Essentials Plus, DIATF certification as an identity orchestrator and FSQS registration. Lender Collect includes encrypted data handling, a full audit trail and controls preventing client data being used to train underlying AI models.
Lender Collect also connects to existing origination and CRM systems via API and webhooks where required.

content: Bitcoin speculators recently moved 55,000 BTC to exchanges as the cryptocurrency dipped below $81,000. This sudden price drop triggered massive crypto liquidations totaling $1.1 billion. Traders reacted to the volatile market conditions by sending their assets to trading platforms, often at a loss, as market uncertainty continued to impact digital asset holders.
content_ta: Bitcoin speculators தங்கள் வசமிருந்த 55,000 BTC-ஐ எக்ஸ்சேஞ்சுகளுக்கு மாற்றியுள்ளனர். Bitcoin விலை $81,000-க்கும் கீழே குறைந்ததால், சந்தையில் $1.1 பில்லியன் அளவுக்கு பெரிய அளவில் லிக்விடேஷன்கள் (liquidations) ஏற்பட்டுள்ளன. சந்தையின் திடீர் வீழ்ச்சியால் வர்த்தகர்கள் தங்கள் சொத்துக்களை நஷ்டத்துடன் எக்ஸ்சேஞ்சுகளுக்கு அனுப்பியுள்ளனர்.

title: Empire Market Co-Creator Sentenced to 40 Years Over $430M Dark Web Bazaar
summary: Raheim Hamilton forfeited some 1,230 BTC. His co-creator Thomas Pavey, who agreed to forfeit 1,584 BTC, is due to be sentenced this month.
content: Raheim Hamilton, a co-creator of the dark web marketplace Empire Market, has been sentenced to 40 years in prison following a massive $430 million drug and contraband operation. Hamilton was ordered to forfeit approximately 1,230 BTC. His co-creator, Thomas Pavey, who agreed to forfeit 1,584 BTC, is scheduled to face sentencing later this month.
content_ta: டேர்க் வெப் சந்தையான Empire Market இன் இணை-நிறுவனர் Raheim Hamilton, $430 மில்லியன் மதிப்புள்ள சட்டவிரோத நடவடிக்கைகளுக்காக 40 ஆண்டுகள் சிறை தண்டனை பெற்றுள்ளார். அவர் சுமார் 1,230 BTC தொகையை இழக்க நேரிட்டது. அவரது இணை-நிறுவனர் Thomas Pavey, 1,584 BTC தொகையை இழக்க ஒப்புக்கொண்டுள்ள நிலையில், இந்த மாதம் தண்டனை பெற உள்ளார்.

title: AI agents can pay for your shopping. Who gets your money back?
summary:

AI agents are getting wallets before merchants get a court, and shopping agents have started placing orders across the open internet. The harder problem arrives once the payment clears, […]
The post AI agents can pay for your shopping. Who gets your money back? appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: Amazon has introduced Bedrock AgentCore Payments, developed in partnership with Coinbase and Stripe. This new system allows AI agents to discover paid services, authenticate, and complete transactions using stablecoins and x402 within preset spending limits. While autonomous shopping agents are now actively placing orders across the internet, a major challenge remains regarding how consumers will secure refunds after a payment clears.
content_ta: Coinbase மற்றும் Stripe நிறுவனங்களின் கூட்டுடன் உருவாக்கிய Amazon நிறுவனத்தின் Bedrock AgentCore Payments அறிமுகப்படுத்தப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த புதிய அமைப்பு AI agents மூலம் கட்டண சேவைகளைக் கண்டறிந்து, stablecoins மற்றும் x402 உதவியுடன் நிர்ணயிக்கப்பட்ட வரம்புகளுக்குள் பணம் செலுத்த அனுமதிக்கிறது. ஆன்லைனில் ஷாப்பிங் செய்யும் AI agents ஆர்டர்களைச் செய்யத் தொடங்கியுள்ள நிலையில், பணம் செலுத்திய பிறகு பணத்தைத் திரும்பப் பெறுவதில் உள்ள சிக்கல் சவாலாக உள்ளது.

content: A recent research report reveals that Strategy's preferred-share buyback program supports a significant portion of trading in its Bitcoin financing instrument, STRC. According to the findings, company repurchases accounted for over 20 percent of weekly trading volume in STRC during nearly every week in September, highlighting a heavy reliance on its own buybacks to sustain the market.

title: MEXC and Payward Highlight Collaboration as Crypto and TradFi Converge at TOKEN2049
summary: October 9, 2026 – MEXC,a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, and Payward, the parent company of Kraken, shared their perspectives on the convergence of crypto and traditional finance during a TOKEN2049 Singapore panel. MEXC CEO Vugar Usi Zade and Payward Co-CEO Arjun Sethi, discussed how broader market access, retail demand and collaboration between platforms could shape the future of global trading. Crypto and TradFi Move Closer Together An important theme was the shift toward more connected, always-on markets. Vugar said blockchain infrastructure is challenging traditional market structures built around fixed trading hours, while users increasingly expect access to different asset classes through a more seamless experience. “Over the next five years, we’ll see a convergence toward a singular platform where asset classes and investments can move quickly and smoothly,” said Vugar. “Retail will be the main driver.” Arjun highlighted the infrastructure challenge behind this shift, noting that 24/7 trading is ultimately about bringing assets and collateral into a more connected financial environment. “24/7 trading really means: how do you bring all that collateral into one place?” said Arjun. Collaboration Over Competition Both speakers also highlighted collaboration as an important part of scaling the next generation of global trading platforms. Arjun noted that serving a much larger global user base will require platforms to work with partners that bring different strengths in their respective markets, explicitly pointing to MEXC as one such example. “The only way to do that is to partner with folks, including MEXC, to be able to help succeed in their core markets,” said Arjun. Vugar similarly emphasized that exchanges can increasingly build on one another’s strengths rather than approach every opportunity purely through competition. MEXC brings a retail-first approach, deep liquidity and broad experience in perpetual markets across crypto and TradFi assets, while Payward brings global financial infrastructure, professional trading capabilities and strong market experience in the United States. The discussion built on the two companies’ earlier indication that they are exploring broader collaboration, with both executives pointing to infrastructure, market access and distribution as areas where greater connectivity between platforms could create value. Trust and access were also highlighted as essential foundations for this evolution. Vugar described trust and access as two of the most important elements in building future financial platforms, while Arjun emphasized the importance of transparency as the industry becomes more connected. The panel pointed to a future in which crypto and TradFi become increasingly connected, with collaboration between platforms helping bring together market access, infrastructure and user reach to serve a broader global audience.   About MEXC Founded in 2018, MEXC is a leading global multi-asset trading platform built as your 0-fee gateway to infinite opportunities. Serving users across 170+ markets, MEXC provides simple and efficient access to crypto, stocks, tokenized assets, derivatives, and a growing range of TradFi-linked opportunities through one account and one gateway.   With 0 trading fees, deep liquidity, broad asset coverage, and a high-performance trading experience, MEXC is designed for retail users who want to discover earlier, act faster, and trade with fewer barriers. As crypto and traditional finance continue to converge, MEXC is committed to making global opportunities more accessible, helping users trade freely and MEXCmize every opportunity.   MEXC Official Website｜ X ｜ Telegram ｜How to Sign Up on MEXC For media inquiries, please contact MEXC PR team: media@mexc.com   Source   Risk Disclaimer: This content does not constitute investment advice. content: At the TOKEN2049 event, executives from MEXC and Payward discussed the growing convergence between cryptocurrency and traditional finance. Leaders from both platforms highlighted how 24/7 trading, blockchain infrastructure, and increased collaboration could shape the future of global markets. They emphasized that partnerships between major trading platforms will be essential to improve market access, scalability, and user trust as retail demand continues to drive the industry forward.
content_ta: TOKEN2049 நிகழ்வில், cryptocurrency மற்றும் traditional finance ஆகியவற்றுக்கு இடையேயான வளர்ச்சி குறித்து MEXC மற்றும் Payward நிறுவனங்களின் உயர் அதிகாரிகளிடையே விவாதிக்கப்பட்டது. 24 மணி நேர வர்த்தகம் மற்றும் ஒத்துழைப்பு ஆகியவை உலகளாவிய சந்தைகளின் எதிர்காலத்தை எவ்வாறு வடிவமைக்கும் என்பதை அவர்கள் சுட்டிக்காட்டினர்.

title: Charles Hoskinson Disputes Vitalik Buterin’s Warning Against Lattice Cryptography
summary: Hoskinson argues that decades of lattice cryptanalysis already inform ML-KEM and ML-DSA security parameters, challenging Vitalik's fears.
content: Charles Hoskinson has challenged Vitalik Buterin's recent warning regarding lattice cryptography. Hoskinson argued that decades of cryptanalysis work already provide a strong foundation for the security parameters used in ML-KEM and ML-DSA. This response pushes back against concerns over the readiness and safety of these cryptographic systems.
content_ta: Lattice cryptography குறித்த Vitalik Buterin-ன் சமீபத்திய எச்சரிக்கையை Charles Hoskinson மறுத்துள்ளார். பல தசாப்த கால cryptanalysis ஆய்வுகள் ML-KEM மற்றும் ML-DSA பாதுகாப்பு அளவுருக்களுக்கு ஏற்கனவே வலுவான அடிப்படையை வழங்கியுள்ளன என்று Hoskinson வாதிட்டுள்ளார். இந்த கிரிப்டோகிராபிக் அமைப்புகளின் பாதுகாப்பு குறித்த அச்சங்களுக்கு இந்த பதில் முற்றுப்புள்ளி வைக்கிறது.

title: 6 Reasons Bitcoin Crashed by $7K in 3 Days: Bull Market Over or Regular Correction?

Analysts are examining the causes behind the steep decline, which include notable ETF outflows and warnings regarding Federal Reserve interest rates. Investors are currently debating whether this sudden downturn marks the end of the current bull market or simply serves as a standard market correction.
content_ta: Bitcoin விலை மூன்று நாட்களில் 7,000 டாலர்கள் வரை சரிந்து பெரும் அதிர்ச்சியை ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த வீழ்ச்சிக்கான காரணங்களாக முக்கிய ETF வெளியேற்றங்கள் மற்றும் Federal Reserve வட்டி விகித எச்சரிக்கைகள் ஆகியவை ஆராயப்பட்டு வருகின்றன. இந்த திடீர் சரிவு தற்போதைய bull market-ன் முடிவா அல்லது சாதாரண correction-ஆ என்பது குறித்து முதலீட்டாளர்கள் விவாதித்து வருகின்றனர்.

title: Bitcoin price tests $80K – Why $402M BTC ETF outflows threaten ‘Uptober’
summary: The Bitcoin regime score needs to push above zero, and the price needs to recover back above $83.2k and $84k resistance to signal a recovery.
content: Bitcoin price recently tested the $80,000 level amid significant ETF outflows totaling $402 million, raising concerns over the market's 'Uptober' momentum. Analysts note that the Bitcoin regime score must rise above zero, while the price needs to break past resistance levels at $83.2k and $84k to signal a true recovery and renew bullish sentiment.
content_ta: Bitcoin விலை சமீபத்தில் $80,000 மதிப்பைச் சோதித்தது. மேலும் $402 மில்லியன் அளவிலான ETF வெளியேற்றங்கள் 'Uptober' சந்தைப் போக்கிற்கு அச்சுறுத்தலாக அமைந்துள்ளன. Bitcoin ஆட்சியின் மதிப்பெண் பூஜ்ஜியத்திற்கு மேல் உயர வேண்டும் என்றும், விலை மீட்சியை உறுதிப்படுத்த $83.2k மற்றும் $84k எதிர்ப்பு நிலைகளைக் தாண்டி மீண்டு வர வேண்டும் என்றும் ஆய்வாளர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர்.

title: ‘Not fast enough’ – Starknet eyes Ethereum exit amid quantum fears
summary: Will Starknet's STRK token benefit more from the post-AI and quantum security narrative?
content: Starknet is reportedly considering a potential exit from Ethereum due to concerns over quantum security risks and the network's processing speed. As quantum technology advances, the blockchain faces growing security challenges, raising questions about whether Starknet and its STRK token can adapt and benefit from emerging post-quantum narratives.

content: Bitcoin recently returned to the breakeven price level for exchange-traded fund holders. title: FintechOS Elevate '26 to Unveil Blue Sky Release as AI Leaders Gather in London
summary:
FintechOS, the agentic platform for unified product operations in financial services, will host its annual Elevate 2026 conference on 14th October at King's Place, London, bringing together executives and AI leaders in financial services for a full day exploring how AI is reshaping product operations in banking and insurance. The invitation-only event will feature the launch of FintechOS 8 Blue Sky, the company's latest platform release. 
Now in its second year, Elevate runs dedicated tracks for banking and insurance, with sessions exploring AI's impact on product operations, customer experience, operational efficiency and governance. The conference will showcase how institutions are moving from AI pilots to production-grade deployment, with live platform demos, keynotes, panels and fireside chats throughout the day. 
Confirmed speakers include Leda Glyptis, author and board advisor; Dharmesh Mistry, author of The Intelligent Ledger and a 40-year veteran of banking technology; Paroma Chatterjee, CEO of Revolut India; and Rania Svoronou, Global Head of AI Design at Citi, along with executives & AI leaders from leading institutions including ElevenLabs, HSBC Innovation, Howden, Societe Generale, the FCA and many others. 
The Blue Sky release marks a shift in how AI operates within banking and insurance, unifying product rules, pricing workflows and semantic data models in a single operational record. 
"AI offers far more than speed to market and cost reduction; it opens genuinely new ways of delivery product innovation and customer satisfaction", said Teo Blidarus, CEO and Founder of FintechOS. "With FintechOS 8 Blue Sky, product and pricing rules, workflows and the semantic data model sit in one record, so AI works inside live banking and insurance operations, not in pilots at the edge. This is a new chapter for FintechOS and for the industry: organisations that build with intelligence and run with intelligence. On 14 October we gather at Elevate '26 to mark the moment and look ahead to what comes next." 
Elevate comes as FintechOS enters a period of accelerated growth. The company recently secured $28 million in combined equity and debt financing to scale its AI-native platform and expand in the US. 
The conference agenda addresses themes central to the industry's current trajectory, with product innovation tracks exploring how agentic AI and unified product operations reduce the time from concept to live product. The day concludes with a networking reception and gala dinner. 
Senior leaders from banks, insurers and the wider financial services ecosystem can apply to join Elevate 2026. Places are limited. Applications will be reviewed by the FintechOS team, with attendance confirmed within two working days. Media interested in attending can also request accreditation through the Elevate website.

title: BDO Unibank Powers Smarter, Next-Generation Payments with Finastra
summary:
Finastra, a global leader in financial services software, today announced that BDO Unibank, Inc. (BDO) has enhanced its payments infrastructure with Finastra’s modern Global PAYplus (GPP), reinforcing the bank’s ability to support growing transaction volumes, strengthen operational resilience, and advance interoperability across the payments ecosystem.
As a leading universal bank in the Philippines, BDO serves retail, commercial, and institutional clients across a broad range of banking and financial services. The bank also supports correspondent banking and fintech partners with payment distribution capabilities into the Philippine market.
The deployment of GPP’s high-value and mass-payments capabilities provides a scalable foundation for current and future payment requirements. BDO currently utilizes the platform for Swift and inbound PESONet processing and is the largest commercial bank in the Philippines leveraging GPP.
With GPP, the bank benefits from greater automation, flexible rule-based payment processing, and improved operational efficiency, while gaining the agility to support evolving industry standards such as ISO 20022 and connect to new domestic and cross-border payment networks as they emerge.
“Payments are a critical enabler of commerce and economic activity, making resilient and scalable infrastructure increasingly important,”  said Carlo B. Nazareno, head of Cash Management Services at BDO. “By enhancing our payments architecture with Finastra’s Global PAYplus, we have strengthened our ability to support growing transaction volumes, improve operational efficiency, and adapt to evolving market requirements. This provides a strong foundation for delivering a seamless client experience today while supporting future innovation across the payments ecosystem.”
“Banks around the world are under growing pressure to deliver payment experiences that are immediate, reliable, and tailored to increasingly diverse customer needs,” said Radha Suvarna, Chief Product Officer of Payments at Finastra. “By bringing high-value and mass-payments processing together on Global PAYplus, BDO is reducing complexity while creating a more flexible foundation for innovation. We are proud to support the bank as it advances its payments capabilities and expands the services it can provide to customers. Our partnership demonstrates both the international capabilities of our solution, as well as our commitment to supporting banks with complex requirements, including multiple clearing systems and nuanced corporate client needs.”
This approach reflects a broader shift in the industry toward unified, AI-enabled payment hubs that consolidate and orchestrate multiple rails. It also reflects the importance of cloud-native, API-enabled architecture, ISO 20022 support, and intelligent operations as important foundations for payments innovation, operational efficiency, and faster time to market.

title: FCA's Andrew Self, Dr Ruth Wandhöfer and Former Big Brother Producer Maz Farrelly Headline Open Banking Expo UK & Europe Next Week
summary:
Open Banking Expo UK & Europe returns to London's Business Design Centre on 13 and 14 October, bringing together more than 1,800 attendees and 200 industry speakers for two days of insight, debate and collaboration at a pivotal moment for Open Banking, Open Finance and Smart Data.
With less than a week to go, final preparations are underway for one of the industry's biggest gatherings of the year, as financial institutions, fintechs, regulators, policymakers and technology providers prepare to explore the opportunities and challenges shaping the future of financial services.
Taking place across four stages of content each day, alongside the Engine Room podcast studio, the event will examine how the industry can move beyond ambition and regulation towards delivering real commercial and consumer value.
With the Smart Data agenda gathering momentum, the continued evolution of Open Banking payments and growing interest in Open Finance, the conversations taking place in London next week come at a critical time for the sector.
Industry-leading keynotes set the agenda
The Main Stage will welcome a diverse line-up of keynote speakers, combining regulatory insight, industry expertise and fresh perspectives from beyond financial services.
On Tuesday 13 October, Andrew Self, Head of Department, Open Banking & Open Finance at the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), will deliver an opening keynote exploring 'Moving from Open Banking into Open Finance: What's needed to unlock the next chapter?'.
His address comes as the industry looks towards the next phase of regulatory and commercial development, with questions around collaboration, innovation and the future framework for Open Finance firmly in focus.
Dr Ruth Wandhöfer, internationally recognised financial services and technology expert, will take to the stage on Wednesday 14 October to explore 'The post-payments world: Open Banking, AI and the new architecture of value'. Her keynote will examine how emerging technologies are reshaping financial services and creating new opportunities for innovation.
Bringing the conference to a memorable close will be Maz Farrelly, the award-winning television executive behind some of the world's biggest entertainment shows, including Big Brother and The X Factor.
In her closing Main Stage keynote, 'Why be boring when you can be bad ass', Farrelly will draw on more than 30 years in television to challenge conventional business thinking and reveal what financial services can learn from showbusiness about capturing attention, communicating with impact and creating unforgettable experiences.
From Open Banking to Open Finance: Turning ambition into action
Across the two days, the conference programme will tackle some of the most pressing issues facing the financial services ecosystem.
The Main Stage will bring together influential voices to examine the direction of Open Banking and Open Finance, while the dedicated Payments Stage will explore the continued growth of Pay by Bank, variable recurring payments and the opportunities presented by account-to-account transactions.
The co-located Open Finance Show will examine the commercial opportunities emerging from greater access to financial data, including new business models, customer propositions and the infrastructure needed to support them.
On Day One, the Smart Data Stage will explore how the principles of Open Banking can extend into other sectors, while Day Two will introduce the Trust & Identity Stage, focusing on the technologies and frameworks underpinning secure digital interactions.
The programme will also feature the new Question Time format, encouraging lively debate and audience participation on the issues shaping the industry's future.
More than a conference: Where the industry connects
Alongside the content programme, attendees will have access to an exhibition featuring more than 40 organisations showcasing the technologies and solutions driving the next generation of financial services.
The Expo floor will provide opportunities to discover new products, meet potential partners and explore practical applications of Open Banking and Open Finance.
The Engine Room returns with recorded conversations bringing together industry leaders for more in-depth discussions, while dedicated networking spaces and facilitated networking sessions will help attendees build valuable new relationships.
With decision-makers, innovators and regulators all under one roof, the event offers an opportunity to move conversations forward, establish partnerships and turn ideas into action.
Celebrating the industry's achievements
The Open Banking Expo Awards 2026 will take place on the evening of Tuesday 13 October, recognising the individuals, teams and organisations making an outstanding contribution to the advancement of Open Banking and Open Finance.
Following a record year for entries, the ceremony will celebrate excellence across the ecosystem, from technological innovation and customer impact to industry leadership and collaboration.
The countdown is on
As Open Banking and Open Finance enter their next chapter, the need for meaningful industry collaboration has never been greater.
Open Banking Expo UK & Europe 2026 will bring together the people, ideas and organisations shaping that future, providing two days of discussion, practical insight and opportunities to build the relationships that will drive the industry forward.
Open Banking Expo UK & Europe takes place on Tuesday 13 and Wednesday 14 October 2026 at the Business Design Centre, London.
With just days remaining, there is still time to join the conversation.

title: 4 Banks and Credit Unions Recognized for AI Innovation
summary:

This year’s winners demonstrate the expanding role of Banking AI — retaining millions in deposits, creating thousands of hours of workforce capacity, resolving customer needs around the clock, and equipping employees with real-time knowledge to fuel personalization and cross-selling. We are proud to partner with them and celebrate their incredible momentum.”
